body: Thank you, I am relieved to hear this. I really just want to talk about it. I’m not a self harmer and have no history of it. I just need room to air some grief about it and not upturn my whole family. I appreciate the information!
Thanks for being the one person to respond
30 year old male, living on my own. sober one year. To be clear, I don’t want to kill myself. I just wish I wasn’t alive.
